name: The St Regis Mexico City
positioning: The St. Regis Mexico City is a 31-story luxury high-rise on Paseo de la Reforma, directly across from the Diana the Huntress fountain
best_for: Travelers who want a Paseo de la Reforma base with round-the-clock butler service
Families, with a supervised Children's Club
Couples or groups wanting a garden terrace suite with private outdoor water features

facts.text: The hotel's address is Paseo de la Reforma 439 in Colonia Cuauhtemoc, Mexico City.
The hotel sits directly across from the Diana the Huntress fountain on Paseo de la Reforma.
The hotel is a 31-story high-rise on Paseo de la Reforma.
The rooms were designed by Yabu Pushelberg.
Rooms have oversized windows looking out on the Mexico City skyline.
Rooms include a free pressing service of two clothing items per day.
Diana Restaurant is named for its views of the fountain of Diana the Huntress.
King Cole Bar is a cocktail bar with a terrace.
King Cole Bar has a smoking lounge for premium cigars and signature cocktails.
Sushi Tatsugoro serves Japanese omakase cuisine.
The Wellness Center next to the fitness center has a sauna, a swimming pool and Jacuzzis with skyline panoramas.
The Children's Club, on the 15th floor, offers supervised play with options including art projects and video games.

highlights.text: In 2024 the hotel launched new garden terrace suites.
The Caroline Astor Garden Terrace Suite has a full-size private infinity pool.
St. Regis Butler Service is offered 24 hours a day, even remotely through eButler, with packing and unpacking, garment pressing and beverage service.
The Krug Room is helmed by Executive Chef Diego Nino in collaboration with the House of Krug; reservations are required.
The hotel offers an exclusive helicopter service.

considerations.text: Pets are limited to small dogs under 17 pounds, and pets cannot be in public areas.
The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's premium positioning.
